name: Meta Form
source:
Surrealist point-and-click adventure game with some word play, a whole lot of escapism, a dab of humor, and a dollop of existential dread.

The idea for the story came from constantly dreaming about being stuck in small indoor spaces and looking for nature. Likely a reflection of living in quarantine.

While not the first creation in The Abandoned universe, this is the first released creation.

[From [url=https://boz-float.itch.io/meta-form]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
超现实主义的点击式冒险游戏，带有一些文字游戏、大量的逃避现实、一点幽默和一点存在主义的恐惧。

这个故事的想法来自于不断梦想着被困在狭小的室内空间中寻找自然。可能是隔离生活的反映。

虽然这不是《被遗弃》宇宙中的第一个作品，但却是第一个发布的作品。

[来自[url=https://boz-float.itch.io/meta-form]itch.io[/url]]
